title: Lunar Landing
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: LUNAR LANDING
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end; exact left/right timing decode match; runtime untested

90 PI=3.14159
100 CLS:LINE(1,0)-(3,0),SET:SET(0,1):SET(4,1)
110 DIM M%(12):GET@(0,0)-(4,1),G,M%
120 GOSUB1000:'DRAW MOONSCAPE
130 X=1:OX=0:HV=-1:Y=0:OY=0:A=PI/2
200 C=PEEK(14400):IFC<128THENT=0ELSET=T-.2:C=C-128
205 IFC=32THENA=A+.2ELSEIFC=64THENA=A-.2
210 X=X+HS+COS(A)*T*.1:HS=X-OX:Y=Y+VS+SIN(A)*T*.1+.05:VS=Y-OY:LINE(A1,B1)-(C1,D1),RESET:A1=X+2:B1=Y+2:C1=A1-COS(A)*T:D1=B1+SIN(A+PI)*T:PUT@(OX,OY)-(OX+4,OY+1),XOR,M%:LINE(A1,B1)-(C1,D1),SET:PUT@(X,Y)-(X+4,Y+1),XOR,M%:OX=X:OY=Y
220 IF X<=127 AND X>=0 THEN200 ELSE END
230 GOTO 200
999 GOTO 999
1000 CLS:REM LUNER SURFACE
